configuration:
[run]
dynamic_context = test_function
branch = True
source = accounts,allocations,audit,hms,hostels,payments,reports,scripts,students
omit =
    */migrations/*
    */tests.py
    */test_*.py
    */apps.py
    */__init__.py
    */settings.py
    */asgi.py
    */wsgi.py

[report]
fail_under = 70
show_missing = True
skip_empty = True
collection_difference_from_tracked_confi: Only dynamic_context = test_function added; no report contexts at collection

commands.name: context-preflight
arguments: import os;os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE','hms.settings');import django;django.setup();from django.db import connection;assert connection.vendor=='mysql' and connection.settings_dict['NAME']=='hms';c=connection.cursor();c.execute("SELECT SCHEMA_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE SCHEMA_NAME='test_hms'");assert c.fetchone() is None,'test_hms exists; identify its owner';connection.close();print('MySQL hms configuration verified; disposable test_hms absent')

environment_scope: Same Python/dependencies and MySQL setup; COVERAGE_FILE, COVERAGE_RCFILE, HMS_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR and PYTHONUNBUFFERED intentionally differ for context collection/output. Not byte-identical process environments.
